title: How a Post
<g>Ships</g>
subtitle: Five steps, one tool each. I only do step three.

cards.title: Writes the first draft
cards.body: From my own best posts, not a blank page.

cards.title: Grades it before I see it
cards.body: Up to three fix rounds against my examples.

cards.title: I say yes, edit or no
cards.body: One click in my inbox. Nothing goes out without it.

cards.title: It goes live
cards.body: Posted at the time I picked.

cards.title: Checks reach after 48 hours
cards.body: The result is saved so the next post learns.

payoff.text: Every edit makes the next post better
